description: This file defines a class 'ADODB2_mssql' extending 'ADODB_DataDict' for handling Microsoft SQL Server database schema operations, including type mapping, SQL generation for altering tables, indexes, and other schema modifications, specifically tailored for MS SQL Server.

classes.name: ADODB2_mssql
classes.description: A class for MS SQL Server specific database schema operations, including type conversions, SQL generation for schema changes, and index management.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps a given type to a simplified internal type code.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual SQL data type corresponding to a meta type code.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to add columns to a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffix for column definitions, including default, identity, nullability, and constraints.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating or dropping indexes with options like UNIQUE and CLUSTERED.

methods.name: _GetSize
methods.description: Determines the size/type string for a given field type.
